use_case_name: Publish Air and Surface Surveillance Tracks

claims.content: To transmit air, surface, or land tracks after achieving Active status and performing sufficient reporting responsibility checks, correlation, and data registration.

goal.raw_text: To transmit air, surface, or land tracks after achieving Active status and performing sufficient reporting responsibility checks, correlation, and data registration.

claims.content: C2 JU
The C2 JU has initially achieved Active status, or has returned to Active status from Inactive status or TDS Failure.
Sufficient reporting responsibility checks have been performed.
Correlation has been performed.
Data registration has been performed.
The C2 JU has completed the minimum wait period (12 seconds for air and surface tracks) after achieving or returning to Active status.

trigger.raw_text: The C2 JU has completed the minimum wait period (12 seconds for air and surface tracks) after achieving or returning to Active status.

claims.content: The C2 JU provides the source of track data (Source TN).
If the C2 JU has the capability to automatically initiate tracks for release without operator action, it shall also have the capability to deactivate this automatic capability.
For real-time tracks, the C2 JU reports the position of the track extrapolated to the time of transmission.
For nonreal-time data, the C2 JU identifies the data as such and provides time tags; nonreal-time track positions are not extrapolated.
The information on the track is reported as complete, accurate, and timely as possible.
Data are correlated and dual designation is minimized.
The proper rules for reporting a track are followed.
If operational necessity requires a shorter wait time or none at all, the C2 JU may override the minimum wait time.
If the track data is nonreal-time, the C2 JU identifies the data as such and provides time tags, and does not extrapolate the track positions.
If a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message is to be transmitted under the condition of automatically purging tracks after a specific time interval, it shall not be transmitted.
Air, surface, or land tracks have been transmitted by the C2 JU.
The information on the track is as complete, accurate, and timely as possible.
Data are correlated and dual designation is minimized.
The proper rules for reporting a track are followed.
